recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-5946 unless a future generated artifact is found to diverge from the authoritative source.
issue_request: FHIR-5946 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction for the Composition discharge summary example. It reports that Bundle.entry.resource/Composition/type/coding used the hostname-only LOINC system value "www.loinc.org" and needed the canonical URI form.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira comments say the fix was made in SVN r4758, and git-svn commit db55db7414cc49a9bd93c668c9fd19c3de26fccf for build@4758 changes source/composition/document-example-dischargesummary.xml from <system value="www.loinc.org"/> to <system value="http://loinc.org"/>.
additional_context: FHIR-5939 is the broader Published/Persuasive Composition example URI-cleanup issue that led to this focused follow-up; its comments also identify the bad LOINC hostname and say it was resolved in SVN r4758. source/fhir.ini lists Composition as an active current resource owned by SD, and no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence records were found.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active discharge summary example has <system value="http://loinc.org"/> at Composition.type.coding, and a repository-wide source search found no remaining www.loinc.org hostname-only values.

related_jiras.note: Broader Composition example URI cleanup; FHIR-5946 was filed because FHIR-5939 pointed at the bad LOINC location while pasting the correct value. The broader tracker was not independently decided here.
